title: Web Development Fundamentals
description: Build a solid foundation in web development through hands-on projects. Learn HTML5 semantic markup, CSS3 (flexbox, grid, responsive design, media queries), JavaScript ES6+ (DOM manipulation, event handling, Fetch API, async/await), and Git version control. Graduate with a portfolio of 3 live websites deployed to Netlify.

title: Python Programming for Beginners
description: Start your programming journey with Kenya's most in-demand language. Covers Python syntax, data types, control flow, functions, modules, file I/O, and exception handling. Learn to work with CSV data, build simple automation scripts, and write introductory data analysis code with Pandas. Delivered in classroom and offline-capable mobile format.

title: Mobile Device Repair and Maintenance
description: Gain practical, income-generating skills in mobile device servicing. Covers smartphone and tablet hardware teardown (screen, battery, charging port replacement), diagnostic tools, software flashing and recovery (ADB, Odin), water damage treatment, and business operation basics for running a repair shop. TVET nationally accredited.

title: Computer Networking Essentials
description: Learn how modern networks function from the ground up. Covers OSI and TCP/IP models, IP addressing and subnetting, Cisco router/switch configuration (IOS CLI), VLANs, STP, OSPF routing, wireless networking (802.11), and network security fundamentals (ACLs, VPN, NAT). Prepares for Cisco CCNA.

title: Digital Marketing and E-Commerce for African SMEs
description: Equip yourself to market businesses online in the African context. Learn social media management (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X), WhatsApp Business API, Google My Business, content calendars, basic SEO, paid advertising on Meta and Google Ads, Mpesa integration for e-commerce, and Jumia/Kilimall seller setup.

title: Graphic Design and Visual Communication
description: Create professional visual content for digital and print media. Learn design principles (typography, color theory, layout, hierarchy), Canva for quick designs, Adobe Photoshop for photo editing and composition, and CorelDRAW for vector illustration. Build a design portfolio for freelancing on Upwork and Fiverr.

title: Computer Applications and Data Entry (MS Office)
description: Master the Microsoft Office suite for office and data entry roles. Covers Word (formatting, mail merge, templates), Excel (formulas, VLOOKUP, pivot tables, charts), PowerPoint (professional presentations), Outlook (email management), and Google Workspace equivalents. Includes typing speed and accuracy training.

title: Electrical Installation and Wiring (Artisan Grade)
description: Gain TVET-accredited electrical installation skills. Covers DC/AC circuit theory, Ohm's Law, safety regulations (IEE Wiring Regulations), domestic wiring (ring final circuits, lighting circuits), installation of MCBs and RCDs, earthing systems, testing and inspection with PAT testers, and solar PV system basics.

title: Cybersecurity Essentials for East Africa
description: Protect individuals and organizations from cyber threats. Covers social engineering and phishing awareness, password hygiene, secure mobile banking (Mpesa safety), public WiFi risks, VPN usage, malware identification and removal, basic network scanning with Nmap, and reporting cybercrime to the Communications Authority of Kenya.

title: Introduction to Cloud Computing for Beginners
description: Demystify cloud computing for learners with no prior IT background. Understand cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), major providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), free-tier account setup, basic VM provisioning, cloud storage, and cloud-based collaboration tools (Google Drive, OneDrive). Pathway to Google ACE or AWS Cloud Practitioner.

title: National Diploma in Full Stack Web Application Development
description: Comprehensive 6-month full-stack developer diploma. Front-end: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React. Back-end: Node.js, Express, RESTful API design, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM. DevOps: Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Railway cloud deployments. Includes a team capstone project and career readiness — CV writing, interview prep, freelancing portfolio.
